messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the design review — evolving the validation UX for Console > Model Pins. main debates: inline microcopy vs persistent helper text, required indicators, and whether deletion confirmations should be inline undo vs modal/typed confirm. sharing a few scenarios. dan: curious about inline microcopy that disappears on focus vs persistent helper under label. which is better for discovery? sophia: persistent helper wins for a11y. Screen reader users need consistent descriptive text — toggling helpers can be missed. we can hide extras with CSS for visual density but keep them in DOM for SRs (aria-hidden only for visual-only). oliver: for visual scan i like short inline hints under labels and a subtle, collapsed "more info" tooltip for advanced stuff. required markers: prefer explicit "(required)" text for clarity and testing. marco: deletion flows: for single pin deletes, show a transient inline toast with undo (5s). for destructive operations that remove model artifacts or change billing, use a modal with typed confirm. mixing both is fine depending on risk. maya: sounds reasonable. can we codify the thresholds? e.g., typed confirm if operation affects storage/billing or >= 3 pins. marco: yep. Threshold: typed confirm when delete affects billing, model artifacts, or >=3 pins. undo-toasts for single quick deletes. require elevated role for bulk deletes. dan: implementation details: keep aria-invalid on inputs, aria-describedby linking to error/help text, and ensure to move focus only once — either to summary or remain on the first invalid field depending on context. keyboard-only users should not be disoriented. a11y-bot: Reminder: do not hide content only with color. Ensure required labels have textual markers. Contrast: error text should meet 4.5:1 for small text per WCAG when it conveys information. sophia: UX nuance: when user corrects an input, animate the error disappearing rather than popping content — helps visual continuity. also announce the fix via aria-live region when errors go from >0 to 0. oliver: copy nits: avoid 'error' in CTAs. use friendlier phrasing: 'Please fix the highlighted fields' and buttons like 'Save changes' not 'Submit'. for deletes, use clear outcomes: 'Delete pin — permanently remove pinned model from this workspace'. maya: small example I'll add to the spec for the inline + summary hybrid: ```html

Please fix the highlighted fields

  • Pin name can’t be blank
``` marco: include rule that clicking summary link must call focus() on input and not just anchor follow — this ensures keyboard focus outline. also record data-error-kind for analytics. dan: mobile rule: if viewport height < 700px, auto-scroll to first inline error and expand the field. desktop: focus summary first. sophia: can we also include a short checklist for QA: keyboard tab order, screen reader announce on submit, contrast checks, undo toast reachable via keyboard? maya: yes. i'll add QA checklist to the spec. I'll push an updated Figma + short spec doc in ~15m. thanks all :thumbsup:
